git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Reject invalid config files instead of falling back

load_config_value silently returned Value::Null for config files
containing explicit null, scalars, or sequences. The merge algorithm
then replaced the accumulated config with Null, and
serde_yaml::from_value(Null) produced BivvyConfig::default() via
#[serde(default)] — causing the app to run with defaults without
any warning.

Now load_config_value validates that parsed YAML is a mapping:
- Empty/comment-only files become an empty mapping (merge no-op)
- Explicit null or non-mapping content produces a ConfigParseError
EOF
